notes.title: New Contents Updates!
notes.content:
Several highlights in this update:
- Executioner's (grunt with two handed sword) might use his grapple attack as finisher
- Gladiator ( the helmet giant grunt ) have NEW bearhug grapple attack
- Hydra is added as a sub boss in stage 3
- It's now possible to change direction in the middle of normal combos
- Overall difficulty is reduced but a new Very Hard difficulty is added (it's basically Hard Mode in previous version & the current Hard Mode is basically Normal Mode in previous version)
- Stage 5 is now longer with some more grunts added and a new Doppleganger boss!
- Lunar Expansion is now executed by up + B instead of down + B
- Lunar Eruption is now executed by down + B instead of up + B

Let me know what you think about new builds & please report any bug you find! Next update will be Steam Trading Cards!
